Reading this page is informational. Required account consent is recorded separately after secure phone verification and remains server-authoritative.
POP products, profiles, links, and files must be used lawfully and without infringing the rights of other people.
POP may restrict abusive, unlawful, deceptive, or security-sensitive content and product use. Your current required Terms version is shown and accepted during secure account setup when applicable.
POP uses your phone number for secure verification and account access. Verification codes are short-lived, single-use, and are not exposed in the interface or logs.
POP limits collection to the information required for the features you choose. Your current required Privacy version is shown and accepted during secure account setup when applicable.
